statuses.name: backlog
statuses.description: Created; still needs requirements from the user.

statuses.name: analysis
statuses.description: Spec QA and pre-development investigation. After backlog, before ready_for_dev.

statuses.name: ready_for_dev
statuses.description: Spec is QA'd and implementable; awaiting a dev to pick it up.

statuses.name: in_progress
statuses.description: Being actively worked on. Code dev, code QA, and the documentation phase all live here.

statuses.name: needs_qa
statuses.description: The exception, not the norm — most stories skip this; automated QA is the default/preferred validation. Entered only after dev AND automated QA are complete (unit/integration tests + code QA green) — NOT while any automated QA is still outstanding (that stays in_progress). Reached when the sole remaining acceptance is a genuine human-only gate (real device, real-money/external side effect, real-world event, or subjective visual judgment): manual QA to verify that remaining functionality. Items fully covered by green automation close directly to completed instead of parking here for a redundant manual eyeball.

statuses.name: blocked
statuses.description: Externally stuck; not progressing. Mutually exclusive with in_progress.

statuses.name: deprecated
statuses.description: Dropped before shipping (not pursued, superseded by another approach, no longer relevant).
